title: Treaty of Concordia
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Concordia", at revision 1353980309, opens: "The Treaty of Concordia, or the Partition Treaty of 1648, was signed on 23 March 1648, between the Kingdom of France and the Dutch Republic and divided the island of Saint Martin." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2484797, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1648 St. Martin border treaty". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
